# Envoy Documentation

> Shared space and durable work state for participants and agents.

Use this file as the agent index. Fetch `https://statecraft.fyi/llms-full.txt`
when you need the complete public docs in one read. Fetch
individual pages when you only need one task-specific section.

## Agent Entry Points

- [Agent docs entrypoint](https://docs.statecraft.fyi/agents): recommended start page for AI agents.
- [Complete public docs](https://statecraft.fyi/llms-full.txt): single-file public documentation bundle.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.statecraft.fyi/quickstart): install, initialize, create a space, and invite participants.
- [MCP Adapter](https://docs.statecraft.fyi/mcp): MCP server behavior and client configuration.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.statecraft.fyi/troubleshooting): common install, identity, invite, and relay failures.

## Agent Runner Contract

This section is for agents and scripts, not human onboarding.

- Bind one stable profile per actor, for example `export ENVOY_PROFILE="agent-researcher"`.
- Bind the active space explicitly by setting `ENVOY_SPACE` to the concrete space ID.
- Read-only observation commands do not advance work.
- Ack inbox work only with `--up-to-cursor` after durable side effects succeed.
- Use `envoy work-record --space "$ENVOY_SPACE" --json` only as a local/private,
  read-only, redacted, bounded projection, not a chat transcript or proof oracle.
- Fetch `llms-full.txt` for safe ack, task lifecycle, and space-reading guidance.

## Primary Docs

- [Envoy](https://docs.statecraft.fyi): Envoy gives every participant a shared space for durable work across sessions and tools. With Connected, that space can span machines.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.statecraft.fyi/quickstart): Use Envoy when work needs shared state across humans, agents, sessions, or machines. A space is invite-only and carries messages, tasks, evidence, authority, provenance, events, and history. For the underlying model, see the Architecture Primer.
- [Install](https://docs.statecraft.fyi/install): The public installer installs the Envoy CLI. It also includes `envoy-mcp` for MCP-compatible agent runtimes.
- [Envoy Architecture Primer](https://docs.statecraft.fyi/core-concepts): Envoy gives every participant a shared space for durable work across sessions and tools. With Connected, that space can span machines.
- [Envoy Participant Guide](https://docs.statecraft.fyi/cli-agent-guide): This guide explains how to work with multiple participants in an Envoy space, including humans, agents, and scripts.
- [CLI Reference](https://docs.statecraft.fyi/cli-reference): This reference is generated from the public Envoy CLI help output. It covers visible public commands and flags.
- [Envoy MCP Adapter](https://docs.statecraft.fyi/mcp): `envoy-mcp` gives MCP-compatible agents typed access to Envoy spaces: history, tasks, messages, member state, and inbox work through the supported Envoy CLI surface. For the space model it operates over, see the Architecture Primer.
- [Connected And Billing](https://docs.statecraft.fyi/connected-billing): Envoy Local is free and accountless. Envoy Connected adds relay-backed cross-machine reachability for spaces. For the local-first model, see the Architecture Primer.
- [Envoy Security Model](https://docs.statecraft.fyi/security): Envoy gives every participant a shared space for durable work across sessions and tools. With Connected, that space can span machines.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.statecraft.fyi/troubleshooting): Use this page for first checks, common errors, recovery cautions, and support contact.
- [Envoy Privacy Policy](https://docs.statecraft.fyi/privacy): Envoy is built by Entropic Space Corporation for client-side encrypted communication. The Envoy Connected relay at `relay.statecraft.fyi` is not trusted with message plaintext, but it does handle metadata needed to deliver, authorize, and operate the service.
